newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Gan urea unit sees record 1996 production.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Gan urea unit sees record 1996 production.

text.p: Agro Nitrogenados, a unit of the chemical division of Grupo Acerero del Norte (GAN), saw a record volume of urea produced in 1996.

GAN, a closely-held firm also in steel and mining, said in its bimonthly magazine that 15 days before the end of 1996 its fertilizer producing unit Agro Nitrogenados surpassed the record 967,626 tonne output of 1995. It gave no new record output for the full year.
Also, GAN said it established a new record for an urea shipment, loading 39,500 tonnes aboard the cargo vessel Bonsai for export to various clients around the world.
GAN added that the Greek vessel Kriti Amethyst shipped from Agro Nitrogenados' Gulf of Mexico dock the largest shipment of the advanced nitrogeneous solution UAN-32.
The shipment of the fertilzer, so-called because it contains 32 percent nitrogen, weighed 35,357 tonnes and went to Texas-based company Noble Agrichem.
No dates were given for the shipment.
